core_problem_solved: To act as a binding that connects the SLF4J (Simple Logging Facade for Java) API to the Log4j 2 implementation, allowing applications that are coded against the SLF4J API to use Log4j 2 as their backend logging engine.
key_features: An implementation of the SLF4J `ILoggerFactory` interface
Delegates all logging calls from the SLF4J API to the Log4j 2 core engine
Allows for a single Log4j 2 backend in projects with mixed logging facade dependencies
era_and_niche: An essential 'bridge' module for projects that wish to standardize on the popular SLF4J API while leveraging the power and performance of the Log4j 2 implementation.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete**. It is an actively maintained and standard component of the Log4j 2 ecosystem for providing SLF4J compatibility.
